title: Normalized derived coefficient unit on the ordinary Tate root line
statement: Let R,S be commutative coefficient rings, φ:R→S a ring homomorphism, N>0 with N=0 in both rings, and T a scheme on which N is invertible. There is a map θ:R_T(1)→Resφ(S_T(1)) on the ordinary etale Tate lines [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], satisfying θ(a tensor z)=φ(a) tensor z on every etale section and the full unbounded derived scalar-unit property [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-scalar]. No flatness of S over R is required.

proof.text: Use the Tate-line Hom equivalence to construct θ from the target root generator. Evaluation at one followed by linearity gives its pure-root formula. The two Hom equivalences identify precomposition with θ with a bijection on all target module Hom sets. The source line has its tensor inverse, so is flat. The proved flat scalar-unit theorem gives the unbounded derived universal property.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_kummer_root_scalar_unit
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hR : (N : R) = 0) (hS : (N : S) = 0) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) :
    ∃ θ : finiteEtaleTateLine T N R hR ⟶
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj (finiteEtaleTateLine T N S hS),
      (∀ (W : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : R) (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf N).obj.obj W),
        θ.hom.app W (finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator R N T hR W a z) =
          finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator S N T hS W (φ a) z) ∧
      SupportedDerivedScalarUnit φ T (finiteEtaleTateLine T N R hR)
        (finiteEtaleTateLine T N S hS) θ
